result_text:
I changed the two mock-resources conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java` (lines 393–394). I didn't add tests or check any of the example paths.

- **Change:** the patterns were `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` and `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*`. They are now `.*/__mock[^/]*/.*` and `.*/mock[^/]*/.*`.
- **What now matches:** any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock`, at any depth. That covers plain `mock/`, `mock.data/`, `mock(old)/` and non-ASCII names like `mock-größe/` and `mock模拟/`. The old names (`mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/`, `mockStore/`) still match.
- **What still doesn't:** `remock/`, `demo/` and `src/main/java/` don't match, because the pattern requires `/mock` right after a slash. Files named `mock.java` or `mockery.java` don't match either, because the pattern needs a `/` after the folder name.
- **Backslashes:** no extra work was needed. `SourceFileFilter.pathMatches` already retries each pattern against a slash-normalised copy of the path.
- **Tests:** `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test -Dtest='ScopingConventions*'` printed nothing. I didn't check whether that pattern matched any test class, so it may not have run any.

I left the existing `.*/mockapi/.*` line alone. The new pattern now makes it redundant.
